{{Quote|Commander Raveen, order our forces to the Outer Rim. From there, we will launch new attacks against the Emperor.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Raveen]]|audio=Zaa04-TFCD.flac|<ref name="DOE">''[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter: Defender of the Empire]]''</ref>}}
[[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s '''coup forces''' was a faction created by the ex-[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] in his attempt to [[Zaarin insurrection|overthrow]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and take over the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Though Zaarin was in good light of the Emperor, he was dissatisfied with Palpatine's rule, and decided to put himself on the throne. Zaarin recruited [[Arden Lyn]], a rogue [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]]. He also attempted to recruit ace [[TIE pilot]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], but failed. His forces first action was an attack above [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] against Palpatine's personal Star Destroyer, the [[Majestic (Imperial-class)|''Majestic'']]. The attack failed, though, as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Stele, and five other pilots saved the Emperor and defeated his forces there. Zaarin's regime then escaped to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], where they continued a campaign against the Empire until he was killed shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

==History==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], during the pursuit of the rogue [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] set forth his plans to overthrow [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in an attempt to assume control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While the Imperials were preoccupied with putting down Harkov's pro-[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces, Zaarin mustered his own personal army in preparation for his takeover of the Empire. Utilizing his vast resources and various advanced technologies, Zaarin was in position to overthrow the Emperor in what he expected to be a swift and complete campaign.

Some time later, Admiral Harkov was captured and subsequently executed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on charges of treachery, and the Imperial loyalists had tracked down his surviving fleet to the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]], where they were aligned with a contingent of Rebel forces. Finding themselves outmatched, the Imperials called on Zaarin and his forces to assist in routing Harkov's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. This was where Zaarin would launch his [[Treachery at Ottega|''coup d'état'']]. Zaarin's forces arrived on the scene as ordered, but instead of helping the Imperials, they attacked the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']], Vader's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. Although the loyalist forces succeeded in driving them off as well as exterminating Harkov's allies for good, the Galactic Empire was weakened, so the Imperial forces loyal to the Emperor raced to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to put an end to the impending coup.

Zaarin later captured and boarded the Emperor's personal flagship, the [[Majestic (Imperial-class)|''Majestic'']]. With Palpatine captured, Zaarin ordered his strike team to deliver the Emperor to him personally on his flagship, [[Glory (Imperial-class)|''Glory'']]. However, he was thwarted when loyal Imperial forces, led by Darth Vader and [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], arrived and rescued the Emperor. With the failure of the coup, Zaarin and his task force fled to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

The failure to overthrow Emperor Palpatine was a severe setback for Zaarin's splinter government, but Zaarin himself remained active. Operating from the ''Glory'' and those bases which remained in Zaarin's control, his insurrectionist forces launched a campaign of terror and sabotage against the Empire. The first step in Zaarin's plan was to strip the Empire with the advanced technologies of his creation that they still possessed, providing him with the technological advantage. He started his campaign by destroying the [[TIE/Advanced starfighter]] [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|Deep Space Manufacturing Facilities]] of [[Omar]]. Although he suffered severe losses, Zaarin and his forces were ultimately successful in destroying all TIE/Advanced facilities in the [[Omar system/Legends|Omar system]], dealing a major blow to the Empire. Zaarin continued his campaign by assaulting the Imperial space station ''[[Research]]'', a facility previously under Zaarin's direct command. By destroying the facility, Zaarin hoped to deny the Empire access to the newly-commissioned [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]], which was still being developed. Once again, Zaarin achieved victory over the Empire by destroying ''Research'', but the surviving TIE Defender prototypes were safely transferred to Coruscant prior to the base's destruction.

This setback however, did not stymie Zaarin's war of attrition against the Empire, as he continued to raid Imperial facilities of valuable technologies and would continue to deny the Empire access to them. In the battle for control of the TIE Defender technology, Zaarin schemed with numerous pirate groups in the Outer Rim Territories to acquire control of the resources and personnel needed to further the development and manufacture of the TIE Defender. One of the consequences of this was the acquisition of the fighter craft by the [[Nami]], a warrior race aligned with the Rebel Alliance. However, this brief but destructive crisis was resolved by loyal Imperial forces before the technology fell into Rebel hands. However, Zaarin still possessed this technological advantage.

The growing threat posed by Admiral Zaarin eventually prompted Emperor Palpatine to promote [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to the rank of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]], filling the vacancy left by Zaarin in the Emperor's inner circle. The Emperor personally charged Thrawn with the destruction of Zaarin and his treacherous fleet. Thrawn's strategy would be to deny Zaarin of his technological advantage through the top-secret development of a heavy starfighter capable of countering the threat posed by Zaarin's fleet of TIE Defenders. This starfighter, the [[Missile Boat]], would spearhead Thrawn's campaign to destroy Zaarin's armada.

Admirals Zaarin and Thrawn sparred in the [[Semag system/Legends|Semag system]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] where Thrawn intended to strip Zaarin of the bulk of his starfleet before a second attempt on the Emperor's life could be staged. Although Thrawn's campaign proved devastating and many forces loyal to Zaarin had been eliminated, losses for both sides were heavy as Zaarin's forces had managed to inflict enormous losses on the advance fleet Thrawn had deployed against the enemy. To lure Zaarin out into the open, Thrawn laid several traps in an effort to bait Zaarin into pursuing top-secret Imperial technologies such as the newly-deployed Missile Boat. Zaarin launched several efforts to gain possession of these and other technologies, but his forces were swiftly routed by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], who flew the Missile Boat with great distinction. However, despite these losses Zaarin was not deceived by the Grand Admiral's ploys and ultimately retreated deeper into the Unknown Regions before Thrawn's forces could confront him directly. Admiral Zaarin was not swayed by the losses he endured however and after successfully acquiring a full squadron of Missile Boats from an Imperial convoy focused his energies on the capture of the Empire's next [[Vorknkx Project|top-secret project]]: A cloaking device being tested aboard the modified [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Vorknkx]]''. In order to ensure shortly after his theft of the Missile Boats that the Imperials could not develop any more Missile Boats, Zaarin's faction also had the factories developing them destroyed in an planetary bombardment, killing thousands. This, as well as an unrelated theft of one of the Missile Boat prototypes, the ''[[Sealion]]'', by the Rebel Alliance, led to the Emperor ordering for any and all surviving Missile Boats still in Imperial custody placed into lockdown and put in a secure location until further notice shortly before Zaarin's final stand.

However, Zaarin was eventually defeated by Thrawn in the [[The Emperor's Will (campaign)|Emperor's Will campaign]], and [[Death/Legends|killed]], after Thrawn exploited Zaarin's dependence on advanced technology by letting Zaarin escape with the ''Vorknkx'' while cloaked, knowing full well that the ship had a critical flaw within its cloaking device would have the ship be utterly destroyed once it entered hyperspace, thus ending his coup.

==Description==
===Organization===
Zaarin governing process was based strictly on a militaristic fashion and it was ruled by a number of officers. They included Zaarin himself and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Raveen]]. What remained of his faction was disbanded after his death, and the deaths of his officers during the final stages of the insurrection.

===Military===
[[File:Glory_isd.jpg|185px|thumb|Their flagship, the ''Glory''.]]

{{Main|Zaarin's fleet}}

Zaarin had a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and other smaller vessels, as well as several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] units. Being a former TIE fighter researcher, Zaarin's forces used experimental models that were largely unavailable to loyalist Imperial pilots. He was also occasionally aided by forces of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. Despite the technological advantage, they were ultimately defeated. All starfighter squadrons, as well as most shuttle and transport craft, were given a "Z-" designation in front of their names when described by loyal Imperial forces, largely for ease of identification during battle. In addition, unlike the mainline Imperial forces, Zaarin's TIE squadrons were modified to come equipped with shield generators.

Their vessels included [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvettes]], including at least three groups known as the [[Arditi group]], [[BaKaar group]], and [[Falcon group]]; [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transports]] and the ''Oz'', [[Z-Ram|''Ram'']] and ''Divine Wind'', including the [[Upsilon group]], Z-Epsilon group, Z-Lambda group, Z-Omega group, and Z-Sigma group as well as the ''Elpi'', the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruisers]] [[Bomb (Immobilizer 418 cruiser)|''Bomb'']], ''[[Harpago]],'' ''[[Grappler]] and [[Maelstrom (Immobilizer 418 cruiser)|Maelstrom]]'', [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wing]] squadrons including the Mu (later Z-Mu), Z-Nu and Tau (later Z-Tau) Squadrons, and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] squadrons including the Z-Alpha, Z-Beta, Z-Delta, Z-Eta, Z-Gamma, and Z-Theta Squadrons, [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s including Alpha Squadron and Z-Zeta, [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttles]] including the [[Hellcat]] and [[Haven group|Haven]] groups, [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] such as the [[Glory (Imperial-class)|''Glory'']], [[Imperator (Imperial-class)|''Imperator'']] and ''[[Thunderer (Imperial-class)|Thunderer]]'', [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]]s including the [[Raptor (Nebulon-B2 frigate)|''Raptor'']] and [[Shadow (Nebulon-B2 frigate)|''Shadow'']], [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] including Z-Delta and Z-Theta squadrons, at least 2 [[Modular conveyor]]s which included the ''Cod'', [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]] such as the ''Coral'', at least three [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] including the ''Caplure'' and ''[[Vorknkx]]'', [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]] including the ''Jumimi'', [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]] including the ''Serpent'', [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] including the Z-Delta Squadron, [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] including the Delta, Iota, and Theta Squadrons, [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]], [[Muurian transport]]s including the [[Z-500 2|''500 2'']], assault transports, [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] including the ''Sigma'' group, [[Beta-class ETR-3 escort transport]]s including the [[Z-Lambda 1|''Lambda 1'']], and others.

Besides the standard military, he also had Force-sensitives led by former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Arden Lyn]], who were personally responsible for capturing the Emperor by using their combined Force abilities to neutralize the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="Barely Tolerable 2">{{SW|url=news/barely-tolerable-alien-henchmen-of-the-empire-part-2|series=Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>
